name: Face Wash | Chando Naturals Lemon Oil Control Face Wash 100ml Gentle Cleanser for Oily and Combination Skin
description:
Refresh and purify your skin with Chando Naturals Lemon Oil Control Face Wash. Infused with lemon extract, this gentle foaming cleanser removes dirt, impurities, and excess oil while helping prevent breakouts. Designed for oily and combination skin types, it leaves the skin feeling fresh, matte, and balanced without stripping natural moisture. With its antibacterial properties and invigorating citrus scent, it’s the perfect daily face wash to maintain a smooth, healthy-looking complexion.Key Features:
 Size: 100ml tube
 Infused with natural lemon extract
 Gentle foaming formula for daily cleansing
 Removes oil, dirt, and impurities effectively
 Helps minimize acne, breakouts, and clogged pores
 Suitable for oily, combination, and acne-prone skinHow to Use:
 Wet face with water
 Apply a small amount of face wash and lather
 Gently massage onto face in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best resultsIngredients:
Lemon extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Mild surfactants, Natural cleansing agentsSafety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
 Discontinue use if irritation develops
 Keep out of reach of children
